deadline.value: Thesis-track PhD applications are due December 1 for the following fall; offers go out February to April.
deadline.quote: For the Thesis Track MS and PhD programs, the application deadline is December 1 for admission the following fall.

gre_general.value: Test scores are not required for the PhD; GRE scores are optional.
gre_general.quote: Test scores are not required for the Master’s Thesis or PhD program.

gre_subject.value: No subject test applies to biology.

toefl_min.value: For tests taken after 1/21/26 the department asks TOEFL 4.5 overall with Speaking 5; older tests need 79 with Speaking 24.
toefl_min.quote: A minimum required TOEFL score of 79 overall (4.5 if taken after 1/21/26) with a minimum required score of 24 on the Speaking portion (5 if taken after 1/21/26)

ielts_min.value: The department asks IELTS 6.5 overall with a 7.0 on Speaking for PhD applicants.
ielts_min.quote: A minimum required IELTS score of 6.5 overall with a minimum required score of 7.0 on the Speaking portion

english_waiver.value: The department waives the test only for a degree from an English-instruction institution earned within two years of enrollment, after at least two years there.
english_waiver.quote: The degree must have been earned within two years of your expected enrollment and you must have attended that institution for a minimum of 2 years.

supervisor.value: PhD applicants are strongly encouraged to contact faculty before applying; the page does not make it a formal requirement.
supervisor.quote: MS (Thesis Track) and PhD applicants are strongly encouraged to contact faculty members in their area of interest to discuss opportunities in their laboratories.

funding.value: All admitted thesis-track students are guaranteed a teaching assistantship.
funding.quote: all thesis students are guaranteed a teaching assistantship

entry_route.value: The page does not say whether a master's is needed for the PhD.

notes: Department English rules differ from the Graduate School's: the TOEFL 4.5 minimum comes with Speaking 5, and the English-medium waiver needs a degree within two years and two years of study at that institution.
